question: A man walking towards a building, on which a flagstaff is fixed vertically, observes the angle subtended by the flagstaff to be the greatest when he is at a distance \(d\) from the building. If \(\theta\) is the observed greatest angle, show that the length of the flagstaff is \(2d\tan\theta\).
